verified_fixes: P1 second (src/retrieval.js:71): the problem now says there are u distinct symbols including 0, repetition is allowed, the length is v, and only the first symbol may not be 0. Under those conditions the count is (u−1)·u^(v−1): u−1 choices for the first symbol and u for each of the other v−1. Because repetition is allowed, nothing limits v relative to u, so the formula holds for v>u as well. The correct choice $(u−1)·u^{v−1}$ matches. The explanation (첫 자리 u−1가지, 나머지 v−1자리 각 u가지) matches. The added sentence saying this is a symbol string, not a multi-digit number, removes the ambiguity. The blocking finding is closed.
